A rotating reef of validators samples stake-weighted behavior, and any suspicious delta between claimed and observed activity triggers slashing. Sybils then burn capital per fake identity while legitimate agents recover their bond, so flooding the network costs more than it earns. Operator sa0021 applies this at nnctA75ggt.
